pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.3: athakho aññataro upāsako yena thullanandā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.6: athakho so upāsako aññatarassa āpaṇikassa gharā kahāpaṇassa sappiṃ āharitvā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā adāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.10: athakho so upāsako yena so āpaṇiko tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ āpaṇikaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.11: na kirayya ayyāya sappinā attho telena attho
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.12: handa te sappiṃ telaṃ me dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.13: sace mayaṃ ayya vikkītaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ puna ādiyissāma kadā amhākaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ vikkāyissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.14: sappissa kayena sappi haṭaṃ telassa kayaṃ āhara telaṃ harissasīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.15: athakho so upāsako ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpessatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.17: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa upāsakassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.18: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpessatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.19: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.21: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.24: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpessati
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.26: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.27.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.1.8: taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ viññāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.1.10: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.1.13: idaṃ me ayye aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.2.1: aññe aññasaññā aññaṃ viññāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.2.2: aññe vematikā aññaṃ viññāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.2.3: aññe anaññasaññā aññaṃ viññāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
